card.name: Linking words inside causal phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words in the middle of a fixed phrase that introduces a reason or a place, such as 'for the sake of', 'as a result of', 'on the basis of', 'because of', 'due to', 'along the'. It fires on the word just before the phrase finishes.

modes.label: Reason phrases
modes.description: A linking word in the middle of a phrase giving cause or purpose, right before 'of' or 'to'.
modes.example: Discontinuation rates for pain and bleeding combined were highest in the first year of use and diminished thereafter. The percentage of females who discontinued Paragard<< because>> of bleeding problems or pain during these studies

modes.label: Sake of
modes.description: The word 'sake' after 'for the' or a possessive.
modes.example: When we work well for the<< sake>> of others, it’s one of the

modes.label: Spatial or manner phrases
modes.description: A short word in a phrase of direction or means, such as 'along the score line' or 'by mouth'.
